strings.history_tip: Includes archived sessions and subtasks. Inherited fork counters are counted once. Missing logs: {0}; read/parse errors: {1}. Indexed history is saved in the companion cache. Amounts are API text-token estimates.
strings.tps_tip: Average for the selected task: {0:N0} output tokens / {1:N1} seconds. Includes reasoning and tool waits, from task start to finish; not instantaneous decoding speed.
strings.buckets_tip: Input {0:N0} / Cache read {1:N0} / Cache write {2:N0} / Output {3:N0}
strings.tokens_tip: Input and output tokens used by the current model in the selected session, including cached input.
strings.context_tip: Context usage from the latest token_count event; it may lag.
strings.scale_tip: Enter 20–100 and press Enter. Character, bubble and card resize together.
